subject.title: Feature Request: TUI Notification When Agent Completes (Sound/Desktop Alert)

question: Should OpenClaw add a default-off TUI-owned completion notification contract, and which modes, platform backends, and config shape should be supported?
rationale: The request is useful TUI ergonomics, but it adds user-visible notification behavior and config surface rather than repairing a broken existing contract, so automation should not choose the product boundary.

options.title: Design default-off TUI notifier
options.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer-owned contract, then implement a narrow opt-in notifier with documented terminal and platform behavior.

options.title: Defer to existing notification surfaces
options.body: Treat local TUI run-completion alerts as outside core unless maintainers identify a missing plugin/API hook or decide existing task/node notifications should be adapted.

recommendation.title: Design default-off TUI notifier
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer-owned contract, then implement a narrow opt-in notifier with documented terminal and platform behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history signal around the TUI status and finalization surfaces that would own the product boundary.
